_comment: Copy to server/config.json and fill in what you have. Everything is optional — the site runs live on the free providers with no keys at all. Environment variables (IV_TWELVEDATA, IV_FINNHUB, IV_MARKETAUX, IV_NEWSAPI, IV_KITEAPIKEY, IV_KITEACCESSTOKEN) override this file.
_marketaux: Free plan is metered per REQUEST and returns 3 articles per request whatever marketauxPageSize says. The server refreshes hourly and spends marketauxPagesPerRefresh requests each time — keep pages x 24 under your daily allowance. Defaults: 3 x 24 = 72 requests/day (limit 100), about 216 enriched stories a day. Raise marketauxPageSize only on a paid plan.
_marketauxSymbols: Which of our symbols each request should ask about. Every request is precious at 3 articles, so it is aimed at the securities the site covers. Omit for the default index+large-cap set.
